source_documents.title: Anti-Kasha’s Rule Fluorescence Emission in (2-Ferrocenyl)indene Generated by a Twisted Intramolecular Charge-Transfer (TICT) Process

reference_evidence_units.quote: Figure 1 shows the emission of 1, with a maximum at 3.1 eV (400 nm)
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1 / (2-ferrocenyl)indene
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Toluene; absorption, emission and excitation spectra, Figure 1.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Emission peaks at 3.1 eV/400 nm, above the lowest absorption maximum at 2.7 eV/460 nm. Excitation spectra associate fluorescence with the higher-energy state.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Anomalous spectral relation supports the source assignment but does not by itself identify the emitting geometry.

reference_evidence_units.subject: 1, 1-4CH3 and 1-6CH3
reference_evidence_units.statement: Compounds were crystallized twice to reduce impurity contributions; calculations also reproduce the low-energy absorption band.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Purity precaution, not complete impurity exclusion. Target in toluene has reported fluorescence yield 2.8 x10^-2.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This demonstrates that the presence of the methyl groups has a great inﬂuence on the anomalous ﬂuorescence observed for these compounds.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Methylated derivatives 1-4CH3 and 1-6CH3
reference_evidence_units.statement: Methylation red-shifts emission to 2.95 and about 2.7 eV and lowers yields to 1.1 x10^-2 and 0.9 x10^-2.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Comparator values not assigned to target; steric and electronic effects both change.

reference_evidence_units.quote: these transitions can be described as a charge transfer from the iron orbitals to the indene and the cyclopenta- dienyl (Cp) moieties
reference_evidence_units.conditions: TDDFT ZORA/SAOP/TZ2P electronic transitions in toluene, orbitals in Figure 2.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The 3.50/3.63 eV transitions are assigned metal-to-ligand charge transfer, increasing negative charge on indene/Cp.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: MLCT character is not evidence for triplet phosphorescence or a separate PET quenching event.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the blue line state, the twisted intramolecular charge-transfer (TICT) state, describes a local minimum of energy
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Dihedral-angle excited-state scan; Figure 4a on PDF p4 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Rotation of indene leads to a model TICT local minimum from which the authors propose photon emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Vertical-excitation scans are not full nonadiabatic dynamics or definitive excited-state pathway proof.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The perturbed states are typical of a conical intersection.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1 and methylated comparison series
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Perturbed excited-state curves during indene rotation, Figure 4.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors identify CI-like behavior between excited states in the rotational scan and connect it with formation of an emitting twisted state.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No demonstrated restricted CI access or CI-mediated nonradiative decay. Retain the reported interpretation without relabeling it RACI.

reference_evidence_units.quote: using a time constant of about 1.3 ns, showing that there is only one emitting state.
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Toluene TCSPC at 400 nm, excitation 375 nm; main-text account of SI decay.
reference_evidence_units.statement: A monoexponential fit gives about 1.3 ns; authors regard it as consistent with one emitting state.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Monoexponential decay alone does not prove unique microscopic geometry; SI trace not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: with an increase of almost 40% with respect to that recorded in toluene.
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Solvent comparison; main text p4 continuing p5.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Fluorescence yield rises to 3.9 x10^-2 in methanol and 3.7 x10^-2 in acetonitrile versus 2.8 x10^-2 in toluene, consistent with CT stabilization.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Solvent dependence is supporting evidence, not an isolated test of TICT; methylated comparators respond differently.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Explicit MLCT-to-TICT interpretation combines orbital/rotational calculations with lifetime and solvent observations.

reference_mechanisms.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Source assigns higher-state anti-Kasha fluorescence through the rotated emitting state.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No source-grounded restriction of intramolecular motion established for this target under the extracted conditions; emission or vibrations alone do not establish RIM.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific external packing or matrix confinement mechanism established in the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific binding of a guest, solvent or analyte that alters emission established.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Explicit MLCT-to-TICT interpretation combines orbital/rotational calculations with lifetime and solvent observations.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer pathway established; hydrogen bonding or an OH substituent alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on established; CT-state character is not by itself a separate PET process.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific aggregate exciton, excimer or exciplex emission established; aggregation alone does not establish this family.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No separate radiative-rate or bright/dark-state balance mechanism established in the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Iron participates in the calculated MLCT, retained under CT; no triplet, metal-centered emission or energy-transfer mechanism is established here.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: CI-like excited-state perturbation is reported, but no restriction of access or CI-mediated nonradiative decay mechanism is established. Do not silently erase the source's CI claim or promote it beyond scope.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Source assigns higher-state anti-Kasha fluorescence through the rotated emitting state.
